**Figure Description: AI-Assisted Federal Survey Harmonization Pipeline**

**1. Overall Layout**
The diagram features a clean, publication-quality academic pipeline design with a pristine white background and a wide aspect ratio (16:9). The overall flow is strictly left-to-right, depicting a sequential process through five major stages. These stages are arranged horizontally across the central part of the canvas, each represented by a distinct, softly rounded rectangle. Thick, prominent arrows with solid lines and clear arrowheads connect these stages, indicating the progression of data and methodology. A thin, full-width banner spans the very top of the diagram, identifying the pipeline.
